goalZh: 会在机场柜台说清楚航班取消了,问还有没有别的航班、能不能改签和安排住处
canDoZh: 能在机场问清楚航班取消后怎么办:改签、等多久、能不能安排住处

newItems.noteZh: 机场、银行、商店的柜台;ou 读 /aʊ/,t 读闪音,结尾卷舌。
a big storm 一场大暴风雨(冬天也可能是暴风雪);st 之间不加元音,or 要卷舌。
遇到麻烦时向工作人员求助:What can we do?;can 弱读成 /kən/,重音落在 do 上。
Is there another one tomorrow? 明天还有别的班次吗?;another 后面跟单数名词或 one。th 是浊音 /ð/。
It's full. 满了(没有位子了);吃饱了也说 I'm full.。u 读短的 /ʊ/,结尾 l 要收住。
because of the weather 因为天气;because 后面接句子(because it's raining),because of 后面接名词。口语常读成“b-cuz of”。
This is awful! 太糟了!;aw 美式读 /ɑː/,和 off 的元音一样。
Come to my house. 来我家吧;house 是房子本身,home 是“家”的感觉。ou 读 /aʊ/,结尾是清音 s。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: Oh no! Our 7:15 to Seattle is canceled! Let's go to the counter.
lines.zh: (周四傍晚,洛杉矶机场的大屏幕上显示航班取消)天哪!我们七点一刻飞西雅图的航班取消了!我们去柜台问问吧。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Excuse me. Our 7:15 is canceled. What can we do?
lines.zh: 打扰一下,我们七点一刻的航班取消了。我们该怎么办?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: I'm sorry. There's a big storm in Seattle.
lines.zh: 很抱歉。西雅图有一场大暴风雪。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Nothing is going there today, because of the weather.
lines.zh: 因为天气原因,今天去西雅图的航班都走不了。

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Yes, tomorrow morning at 9:10. It isn't full.
lines.zh: 有,明天早上九点十分,还没满。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Great. Can we get on that one?
lines.zh: 太好了。我们能改到那一班吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sure. Here are your new tickets.
lines.zh: 可以。这是你们的新机票。

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: This is awful! Can you give us a room for tonight?
lines.zh: 太糟了!今晚能给我们安排个房间吗?

lines.speaker: staff
lines.text: Sorry. Because of the weather, we can't pay for rooms.
lines.zh: 抱歉。因为是天气原因,我们不能负责住宿。

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: 好吧……我们给伊森打个电话。

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Relax, guys! Come to my house tonight.
lines.zh: (电话里)别急,你们俩!今晚来我家住吧。

questions.prompt: 他们的航班为什么取消了?
options: 西雅图有一场大暴风雪
questions.explainZh: 工作人员说 There's a big storm in Seattle. Nothing is going there today, because of the weather.。
工作人员说 tomorrow morning at 9:10,磊问 Can we get on that one?,对方说 Sure.。
工作人员说 we can't pay for rooms,伊森在电话里说 Come to my house tonight.。

grammar.titleZh: 遇到麻烦去柜台:What can we do? / Is there another one? / Can we get on…?
grammar.bodyZh: 航班取消了(canceled,第 9 单元学过 Classes are canceled.),到柜台先说清楚情况:Our 7:15 is canceled.(我们七点一刻的航班取消了)——机场里常用起飞时间来指航班。然后问怎么办:What can we do?(我们该怎么办?)。问有没有别的:Is there another one tomorrow?,another one 指“另一班”。想改到某一班:Can we get on that one?(get on 第 5 单元说上公交,上飞机也用它)。要住处:Can you give us a room for tonight?。听到 It isn't full.(没满)就是还有位子,It's full. 就是满了。

examples.text: Our 7:15 is canceled. What can we do?
examples.zh: 我们七点一刻的航班取消了。我们该怎么办?

examples.text: Can we get on that one?

grammar.titleZh: because of + 名词;Excuse me 的升调和降调
grammar.bodyZh: 说原因:because 后面接一个完整的句子(because it's raining),because of 后面只接名词(because of the weather、because of the storm)。中国学生常说成 because the weather——别漏了 of。发音:在柜台前叫住工作人员,Excuse me? 用升调 ↗,意思是“打扰一下,请问……”;不小心碰到人、要借过时,Excuse me. 用降调 ↘,意思是“不好意思”。

examples.text: Nothing is going there, because of the weather.
examples.zh: 因为天气原因,什么航班都去不了那儿。

examples.text: We can't go home because of the storm.
examples.zh: 因为暴风雪,我们回不了家。
